<!-- Thank you for your contribution! Please follow these guidelines to enhance your pull request. If anything is unclear, submit your PR and reach out to maintainers for assistance. Join our Slack community at https://slack.sglang.io to discuss further. -->

## Motivation

Image-to-3D in ComfyUI currently needs the fragile per-package Hunyuan3D installs. The SGLang Diffusion server already serves Hunyuan3D through `POST /v1/meshes`, so a server-mode node can give ComfyUI users image-to-3D with no extra installs, and the result plugs into ComfyUI's built-in 3D preview.

## Modifications

- `SGLDiffusionGenerateMesh` node (server mode). Inputs: the server client, an image, and optional `output_format` (glb or obj), `seed`, `steps` and `guidance_scale` (-1 / 0 keep the server defaults). Outputs: ComfyUI's `FILE_3D` type (accepted by `Preview 3D` and `Preview 3D (Advanced)`) and the saved file path. The mesh is saved under the ComfyUI output directory in `mesh/`.
- `SGLDiffusionServerAPI.generate_mesh` uploads the image as multipart, then polls the job. `fetch_mesh` puts the file in place: it copies it when the server shares the filesystem, downloads it from the cloud URL when the server stored it in cloud storage (the API key is not sent to that host), and otherwise downloads it from `/v1/meshes/{id}/content`.
- Example workflow `sgld_image_to_3d.json` and README entries.
- No paint (texturing) toggle. Texturing is chosen when the server is launched (the Hunyuan3D `paint_enable` setting), and `MeshGenerationsRequest` has no field for it, so a node option would do nothing. A per-request option would need a server-side change.

## Accuracy Tests

Against a real server on a GPU (L40S): `sglang serve --model-path tencent/Hunyuan3D-2` (the launch used by the repo's pinned CI case; there is no Hunyuan3D cookbook page) with the CI test image.
- GLB: job completed, 23.9 MB, valid `glTF` header, 536,896 vertices and 705,768 faces. The first request took 270 s on a cold server.
- Remote download path: byte-identical to the server's own file.
- OBJ: real vertices and faces.
- The node, run with a real ComfyUI checkout: returns a genuine `File3D` (format `glb`) and saves the file.

CPU unit tests (`test_comfyui_mesh.py`) run the client against a local HTTP server that speaks the job protocol, covering the multipart upload fields, polling, failure messages, the three file sources, and unset options not being sent: 6 pass without ComfyUI, 7 with it. The related ComfyUI tests pass (69 passed). The lint hooks pass at the repo's pinned versions, and the example workflow validates against ComfyUI's node definitions.

Not covered: a textured mesh (depends on the server's paint setting), a server behind cloud storage, and AMD (the repo skips Hunyuan3D on ROCm).

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not applicable beyond the timing above.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [x] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`

nodes.body: This seems to only call the SGLang endpoint. Is there a case that needs a dedicated node? If not, I'd rather not add it.

The case is textured output.

ComfyUI's built-in Hunyuan3D nodes give you only the shape. This node uses SGLang to add the textures; the result is a textured model with nothing to install, and it doesn't use up ComfyUI's GPU memory.

@@ -24,6 +24,7 @@ The plugin supports two modes of operation: **Server Mode** (via HTTP API) and *
 - **Z-Image**: High-speed image generation models (e.g., `Z-Image-Turbo`)
 - **FLUX**: State-of-the-art text-to-image models (e.g., `FLUX.1-dev`)
 - **Qwen-Image**: Multi-modal image generation models (e.g., `Qwen-Image`,`Qwen-Image-2512`). *Note: Image editing support is currently experimental and may have some issues.*
+- **Hunyuan3D (image-to-3D)**: Server mode only. `SGLDiffusion Generate Mesh` sends an image to `/v1/meshes` and returns the GLB or OBJ as ComfyUI's 3D file type (plus its path), so it plugs into `Preview 3D`. Whether the mesh is textured depends on how the server was launched (the Hunyuan3D `paint_enable` setting); it is not a per-request option.
 - **Qwen-Image-2.1**: Integrated mode (`model_type=qwen_image21`, auto-detected) for Comfy-Org's `qwen_image_2.1_bf16.safetensors` or INT8 `qwen_image_2.1_int8_convrot.safetensors`. Text-to-image and reference-image edit work with the official templates after swapping `UNETLoader` for `SGLDUNETLoader`. The worker manages the prefix K/V cache itself, so the `Qwen Image 2.1 Cache` node's options are ignored. Multi-GPU: Ulysses / Ring or TP through the manual layout in `SGLDiffusion Options`. DiT patches (Fun-Control, attention hooks) are not supported. LoRA: use `SGLDiffusion LoRA Loader` instead of `LoraLoaderModelOnly`. Tested with `Viggle/Qwen-Image-2.1-viggle-turbo` (`...-v0.3-6step-lora-r128.safetensors`): euler, `BasicGuider`, `ManualSigmas` `1.0, 0.967754, 0.933358, 0.857192, 0.666756, 0.400096, 0` at 1024x1024.
 - **MiniMax-H3**: Joint video-and-audio DiT (`model_type=minimax_h3`). Integrated mode: T2V / I2VA / FL2VA use an `fl2va` checkpoint; R2V needs `ref2va`. CLIP and VAE stay in ComfyUI. Server mode uses `SGLDiffusion Generate MiniMax-H3`.
 
@@ -122,6 +123,7 @@ Reference workflow files are provided in the `workflows/` directory:
 - **`z-image_sgld.json`**: High-speed image generation using Z-Image.
 - **`sgld_text2img.json`**: Server-mode text-to-image generation with LoRA support.
 - **`sgld_image2video.json`**: Server-mode image-to-video generation.
+- **`sgld_image_to_3d.json`**: Server-mode image-to-3D (Hunyuan3D): `SGLDiffusion Generate Mesh` returns a GLB or OBJ for ComfyUI's `Preview 3D`.
 - **`qwen_image21_t2i_sgld.json`**: Qwen-Image-2.1 text-to-image. For reference edit, use the official template with `SGLDUNETLoader`.
 - **`minimax_h3_t2v_sgld.json`**: MiniMax-H3 T2V / I2VA / FL2VA (`fl2va` DiT).
 - **`minimax_h3_r2v_sgld.json`**: MiniMax-H3 reference-to-video (`ref2va` DiT).

+def _safe_job_id(job_id: Any) -> str:

+def _is_within(path: str, root: str) -> bool:
+    path, root = os.path.realpath(path), os.path.realpath(root)
+    try:

+def mesh_dest_path(output_dir: str, job: Dict[str, Any], fallback_format: str) -> str:

+    if fmt not in MESH_FORMATS:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"Server returned an unsupported mesh format: {fmt!r}")
+    dest = os.path.join(output_dir, f"sgld_{_safe_job_id(job.get('id'))}.{fmt}")

+    def generate_mesh(
+        self,
+        image_path: str,
+        output_format: str = "glb",
+        seed: Optional[int] = None,
+        num_inference_steps: Optional[int] = None,
+        guidance_scale: Optional[float] = None,
+        poll_interval: float = 3.0,
+        max_wait_time: float = 1800.0,
+    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+        """Generate a mesh from an image (POST /v1/meshes) and wait for the job.
+
+        Texturing is decided by how the server was launched, not per request.
+        Returns the completed job dict.
+        """
+        form: Dict[str, Any] = {"output_format": output_format}
+        if seed is not None and seed >= 0:
+            form["seed"] = seed
+        if num_inference_steps:
+            form["num_inference_steps"] = num_inference_steps
+        if guidance_scale is not None and guidance_scale >= 0:
+            form["guidance_scale"] = guidance_scale
+
+        # multipart upload: the shared headers pin Content-Type to JSON
+        headers = {"Authorization": self.headers["Authorization"]}
+        try:
+            with open(image_path, "rb") as image_file:
+                response = requests.post(
+                    f"{self.base_url}/meshes",
+                    data=form,
+                    files={
+                        "image": (
+                            os.path.basename(image_path),
+                            image_file,
+                            self._get_content_type(image_path),
+                        )
+                    },
+                    headers=headers,
+                    timeout=60,
+                )
+            response.raise_for_status()
+            return self._wait_for_job(
+                "meshes", response.json()["id"], poll_interval, max_wait_time
+            )
+        except requests.exceptions.RequestException as e:
+            raise RuntimeError(f"Failed to generate mesh: {str(e)}")
+
+    def _wait_for_job(
+        self, collection: str, job_id: str, poll_interval: float, max_wait_time: float
+    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+        max_consecutive_errors = 5
+        consecutive_errors = 0
+        start_time = time.time()
+        while time.time() - start_time < max_wait_time:
+            try:
+                response = requests.get(
+                    f"{self.base_url}/{collection}/{job_id}",
+                    headers=self.headers,
+                    timeout=30,
+                )
+                response.raise_for_status()
+                status = response.json()
+                consecutive_errors = 0
+                if status.get("status") == "completed":
+                    return status
+                if status.get("status") == "failed":
+                    error = status.get("error") or {}
+                    raise RuntimeError(
+                        f"Generation failed: {error.get('message', 'Unknown error')}"
+                    )
+            except requests.exceptions.RequestException as e:
+                consecutive_errors += 1
+                if consecutive_errors >= max_consecutive_errors:
+                    raise RuntimeError(
+                        f"Lost the server after {consecutive_errors} consecutive "
+                        f"errors: {str(e)}"
+                    )
+            time.sleep(poll_interval)
+        raise TimeoutError(f"Generation timed out after {max_wait_time} seconds")
+
+    def fetch_mesh(
+        self,
+        job: Dict[str, Any],
+        dest_path: str,
+        local_roots: Optional[Sequence[str]] = None,
+    ) -> str:
+        """Put a completed mesh job's file at dest_path and return it.
+
+        The server's file_path is only copied when it resolves inside one of
+        local_roots (the server's output dirs, shared with this host); any other
+        path the server names is ignored so it cannot make us read arbitrary
+        local files. Otherwise the file is downloaded from the cloud url (only
+        https or the server's own host, without the API key) or from the
+        server's /content endpoint.
+        """
+        os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(dest_path) or ".", exist_ok=True)
+        local_path = job.get("file_path")
+        if (
+            local_path
+            and local_roots
+            and any(_is_within(local_path, root) for root in local_roots)
+            and os.path.isfile(local_path)
+        ):
+            shutil.copyfile(local_path, dest_path)
+            return dest_path
+        if job.get("url"):
+            url, headers = job["url"], {}
+            parsed = urlparse(url)
+            same_host = parsed.netloc == urlparse(self.base_url).netloc
+            if parsed.scheme not in ("http", "https") or not (
+                parsed.scheme == "https" or same_host
+            ):
+                raise RuntimeError(f"Refusing to download mesh from {url!r}")
+        else:
+            url = f"{self.base_url}/meshes/{_safe_job_id(job.get('id'))}/content"
+            headers = {"Authorization": self.headers["Authorization"]}
+        deadline = time.monotonic() + MESH_DOWNLOAD_DEADLINE_S
+        try:
+            with requests.get(url, headers=headers, stream=True, timeout=120) as r:
+                r.raise_for_status()
+                size = 0
+                with open(dest_path, "wb") as out:
+                    for chunk in r.iter_content(chunk_size=1 << 20):
+                        size += len(chunk)
+                        if size > MAX_MESH_BYTES:
+                            raise RuntimeError("Mesh download exceeds 2 GiB")
+                        if time.monotonic() > deadline:
+                            raise RuntimeError("Mesh download timed out")
+                        out.write(chunk)
+        except (requests.exceptions.RequestException, RuntimeError) as e:
+            if os.path.exists(dest_path):
+                os.remove(dest_path)
+            raise RuntimeError(f"Failed to download mesh: {str(e)}")
+        return dest_path

issue_comments.body: This seems to only call the SGLang endpoint. Is there a case that needs a dedicated node? If not, I'd rather not add it.

The case is textured output.

ComfyUI's built-in Hunyuan3D nodes give you only the shape. This node uses SGLang to add the textures; the result is a textured model with nothing to install, and it doesn't use up ComfyUI's GPU memory.
